title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security on Issuing the Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Handling of Criminal Cases of Illegal Fundraising
keywords_en: Securities; Fraud; Handling of illegal fundraising criminal cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court Supreme People's Procuratorate Ministry of Public Security

Notice on Issuing the Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Handling of Criminal Cases of Illegal Fundraising

Gao Jian Hui [2019] No. 2

The High People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, and Public Security Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army, the Military Procuratorate of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Division of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, the People's Procuratorate of Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, and the Public Security Bureau:

In order to legally punish criminal activities of illegal fundraising such as illegally absorbing public deposits and fundraising fraud, to maintain the national financial management order, and to protect the lawful rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations, the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security hereby jointly issue the Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Handling of Criminal Cases of Illegal Fundraising. Please conscientiously implement them.

January 30, 2019

Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Handling of Criminal Cases of Illegal Fundraising

In order to legally punish criminal activities of illegal fundraising such as illegally absorbing public deposits and fundraising fraud, to maintain the national financial management order, and to protect the lawful rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations, in accordance with the Criminal Law, the Criminal Procedure Law, and other legal provisions, and in light of judicial practice, the following opinions are hereby put forward on issues related to the handling of criminal cases of illegal fundraising such as illegally absorbing public deposits and fundraising fraud:

1. Regarding the Basis for Determining the "Illegality" of Illegal Fundraising

When the People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, and Public Security organs determine the "illegality" of illegal fundraising, they shall take the national financial management laws and regulations as the basis. Where the national financial management laws and regulations only contain principled provisions, the determination may be made based on the spirit of the law and with reference to the department rules formulated by the People's Bank of China, the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, the China Securities Regulatory Commission, and other competent administrative departments in accordance with the national financial management laws and regulations, or the provisions of normative documents such as state regulations, measures, and implementation rules on financial management.

2. Regarding the Determination of Unit Crimes

Where a unit commits a criminal activity of illegal fundraising and all or most of the illegal proceeds belong to the unit, it shall be determined as a unit crime.

Where a unit is established by an individual for the purpose of committing a criminal activity of illegal fundraising and then commits the crime, or where, after the establishment of a unit, its main activity is committing a criminal activity of illegal fundraising, it shall not be dealt with as a unit crime. The persons who organize, plan, and implement the criminal activity of illegal fundraising within the unit shall be investigated for criminal responsibility as natural persons according to law.

Whether a unit's main activity is committing a criminal activity of illegal fundraising shall be comprehensively considered and determined based on factors such as the number of times the unit has engaged in illegal fundraising, the frequency, duration, scale of funds, flow of funds, the amount of human and material resources invested, the unit's legitimate business status, and the impact and consequences of the criminal activity.

3. Regarding the Handling of Involved Subsidiary Units

When handling criminal cases of illegal fundraising, the People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, and Public Security organs shall comprehensively investigate the involved units, including the superior units (head offices, parent companies) and subsidiary units (branches, subsidiaries), regarding their subject qualifications, levels, relationships, status, roles, fund flows, etc., and shall deal with them according to law based on the specific circumstances.

Where the superior unit has been determined to constitute a unit crime, and the subsidiary unit commits a criminal activity of illegal fundraising, and all or most of the illegal proceeds belong to the subsidiary unit, the subsidiary unit shall also be determined to constitute a unit crime. Where the superior unit and the subsidiary unit constitute a joint crime, the criminal responsibility of the criminal units shall be determined based on their status and role.

Where the superior unit has been determined to constitute a unit crime, and the subsidiary unit commits a criminal activity of illegal fundraising, but all or most of the illegal proceeds belong to the superior unit, the subsidiary unit shall not be separately determined to constitute a unit crime. The persons suspected of crime in the subsidiary unit may be investigated for criminal responsibility as other persons directly responsible of the superior unit according to law.

Where the superior unit is not determined to constitute a unit crime, but the subsidiary unit is determined to constitute a unit crime, the persons in the superior unit who organize, plan, and implement the illegal fundraising crime may generally be dealt with as a joint crime between a natural person and a unit together with the subsidiary unit.

Where neither the superior unit nor the subsidiary unit is determined to constitute a unit crime, generally, the persons in charge who assume responsibilities for organization, leadership, management, and coordination in the superior unit and the subsidiary unit, and the persons who play a major role, shall be treated as principal offenders, while other persons who actively participate in the illegal fundraising crime shall be treated as accessory offenders, and they shall be dealt with as a joint crime of natural persons.

4. Regarding the Determination of Subjective Intent

Whether a criminal suspect or defendant has the criminal intent to illegally absorb public deposits shall be comprehensively analyzed and determined based on evidence such as the criminal suspect's or defendant's position, professional experience, professional background, training experience, prior administrative penalties or criminal prosecutions for similar acts, and the methods of absorbing funds, publicity and promotion, contract materials, business processes, etc., combined with their statements.

Where a criminal suspect or defendant uses fraudulent methods for illegal fundraising and meets the requirements of Article 4 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases of Illegal Fundraising, it may be determined as "having the purpose of illegal possession" in the crime of fundraising fraud.

When handling criminal cases of illegal fundraising, the case-handling organs shall, based on the specific circumstances of the case, pay attention to collecting and utilizing the following evidence involving the criminal suspect or defendant: whether false identity information was used to conduct business externally; whether contracts or agreements were fraudulently concluded; whether false publicity was made, clearly exceeding the business scope or exaggerating business, investment, service projects, and profitability; whether funds were concealed or contracts, agreements, or accounts were destroyed after absorbing funds; whether methods to circumvent the law or evade supervision were taught or accepted, etc.

5. Regarding the Determination of the Amount of Crime

Where illegally absorbing or disguisedly absorbing public deposits constitutes a crime, and any of the following circumstances exists, the funds absorbed from relatives, friends, or internal personnel of the unit shall be included in the criminal amount together with the funds absorbed from unspecified objects:

(1) During the process of absorbing funds from relatives, friends, or internal personnel of the unit, the person knowingly allows relatives, friends, or internal personnel of the unit to absorb funds from unspecified objects;

(2) For the purpose of absorbing funds, social persons are absorbed as internal personnel of the unit, and funds are absorbed from them;

(3) Publicity is made to the public, and funds are absorbed simultaneously from unspecified objects, relatives, friends, or internal personnel of the unit.

The amount of illegally absorbed or disguisedly absorbed public deposits shall be calculated based on the total amount of funds absorbed by the actor. The amount of repeated investment after the fundraising participant recovers the principal or receives returns shall not be deducted, but may be considered as a sentencing circumstance at the court's discretion.

6. Regarding the Implementation of the Criminal Policy of Combining Leniency with Severity

When handling criminal cases of illegal fundraising, the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity shall be implemented, the scope of criminal responsibility shall be legally and reasonably determined, and both criminal and administrative means shall be comprehensively used to handle and resolve risks, achieving the goal of punishing a few and educating and saving the majority. The severity of the actor's responsibility and the necessity of criminal prosecution shall be comprehensively judged based on the actor's objective conduct, subjective malignancy, criminal circumstances, status, role, level, position, etc., and the persons involved shall be dealt with by classification according to the principle of differential treatment, ensuring that the punishment fits the crime and the responsibility and punishment are proportionate.

The focus of punishment shall be on the organizers, leaders, and managers of illegal fundraising criminal activities, including the core, management, and backbone personnel of the superior units (head offices, parent companies) in unit crimes, the management and backbone personnel of subsidiary units (branches, subsidiaries), and other persons who play a major role.

For persons involved who actively cooperate with the investigation, voluntarily return illegal gains and make restitution, and sincerely confess and repent, a lighter punishment may be given according to law; where the circumstances are minor, punishment may be exempted; where the circumstances are obviously minor and the harm is not significant, the matter shall not be dealt with as a crime.

7. Regarding Jurisdiction

Cross-regional criminal cases of illegal fundraising shall be handled in accordance with the working principles determined in the Opinions of the State Council on Further Improving the Work of Preventing and Handling Illegal Fundraising (Guo Fa [2015] No. 59). If it is more appropriate to consolidate the investigation and prosecution, they may be handled jointly.

When handling cross-regional criminal cases of illegal fundraising, if multiple public security organs have the authority to file a case for investigation, generally, the public security organ of the main crime location shall be the case lead organ, responsible for filing the case against the main criminal suspects and transferring them for review and prosecution; the public security organs of other crime locations shall be case sub-organs, which, based on the specific circumstances of the case, shall file cases against local criminal suspects and transfer them for review and prosecution.

Where jurisdiction is unclear or disputed, the common superior public security organ shall, in accordance with the principles of facilitating the ascertainment of criminal facts and facilitating the proceedings, coordinate to determine or designate a relevant public security organ as the case lead organ to file the case for investigation. For requests for approval of arrest, transfer for review and prosecution, and public prosecution, the People's Procuratorate and People's Court at the location of the public security organ that filed the case for investigation shall accept them.

For major, difficult, and complex cross-regional criminal cases of illegal fundraising, while coordinating to determine or designate the case lead organ to file the case for investigation, the public security organ shall simultaneously notify the People's Procuratorate and the People's Court at the same level. The People's Procuratorate and People's Court shall, by reference to the preceding paragraph, determine the main crime location as the case lead location, and other crime locations as case sub-locations, with the People's Procuratorate and People's Court at those locations responsible for prosecution and trial.

The "main crime location" referred to in this Article includes the main location where the illegal fundraising activity was organized, planned, and implemented; the place of registration, principal place of business, and principal place of office of the fundraising actor; and the main location of the fundraising participants.

8. Regarding the Case Handling Working Mechanism

The case-handling organs at the case lead location and other involved locations shall maintain close communication and coordination, collaboratively advance the investigation, prosecution, trial, and asset disposal work, and cooperate with relevant departments to maximize the recovery of losses and stolen goods.

The case-handling organ at the case lead location shall be uniformly responsible for filing the case, investigating, prosecuting, and trying all criminal facts of illegal fundraising suspected of the main criminal suspect or defendant, to prevent omission of criminal facts; and shall notify the case-handling organs at other involved locations of the overall case handling policy, the evidence requirements and litigation deadlines for prosecuting the main criminal suspect or defendant, the work requirements for recovery of losses and stolen goods and asset disposal, etc. The case-handling organs at other involved locations shall promptly file cases, investigate, prosecute, and try the criminal facts of illegal fundraising suspected of local criminal suspects or defendants, and actively assist the case lead location in handling the involved assets.

The case-handling organs at the case lead location and other involved locations shall establish and improve a mechanism for exchanging and sharing evidence. Evidence involving the main criminal suspect or defendant shall generally be collected by the case-handling organ at the case lead location, with other involved locations providing assistance. The case-handling organ at the case lead location shall promptly notify the procedures and requirements for receiving evidence materials involving the main criminal suspect or defendant. If a case-handling organ at another involved location requires the case lead location to provide evidence materials, it shall submit an evidence request to the case-handling organ at the case lead location, which shall collect and legally transfer the evidence. If the original evidence cannot be transferred, a copy shall be transferred along with an explanation in accordance with relevant provisions.

9. Regarding the Recovery and Disposal of Involved Property

When handling cross-regional criminal cases of illegal fundraising, the case-handling organ at the case lead location shall promptly collect the involved property, laying the groundwork for unified asset disposal. The case-handling organs at other involved locations shall promptly ascertain the involved property, clarify its source, destination, purpose, and flow, legally handle the procedures for sealing, seizing, and freezing, prepare detailed lists, establish detailed accounts for the seized funds, deposit them immediately into the sole compliant account of the case-handling organ after seizure, and provide the relevant information to the case-handling organ at the case lead location.

The People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, and Public Security organs shall strictly comply with the Criminal Procedure Law and relevant judicial interpretations, and legally transfer, review, and handle the involved property that has been sealed, seized, or frozen. For illegal gains that have not been recovered or have not been fully refunded at the time of trial, the People's Court shall order continued recovery or restitution, and the People's Court shall be responsible for enforcement. The functional department for handling illegal fundraising, the People's Procuratorate, and the Public Security organ shall cooperate.

After the People's Court renders a judgment on the involved property according to law, the relevant localities and departments shall, under the overall coordination of the functional department for handling illegal fundraising, earnestly fulfill their obligations of cooperation, comprehensively use multiple means, and properly carry out the removal of involved property, realization of property, collection of funds, and refund of funds, ensuring that actual losses are minimized to the greatest extent.

According to relevant regulations, the involved property that has been sealed, seized, or frozen shall generally be returned to the fundraising participants after the conclusion of the proceedings. If the involved property is insufficient for full restitution, it shall be returned in proportion to the amount of funds contributed by the fundraising participants. Compensation for losses of fundraising participants shall generally take priority over other civil debts and the execution of fines and confiscation of property.

10. Regarding the Protection of Rights of Fundraising Participants

Fundraising participants refer to units and individuals who have invested funds in illegal fundraising activities, excluding units and individuals who have provided assistance to illegal fundraising activities and obtained economic benefits.

The People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, and Public Security organs shall protect the lawful rights of fundraising participants according to law by promptly publicizing the progress of the case and the status of the involved assets. Fundraising participants may elect representatives to submit opinions and suggestions to the People's Court; if representatives cannot be elected, the People's Court may designate representatives. The People's Court may, depending on the circumstances of the case, decide whether the representatives of the fundraising participants may participate in or observe the trial. Requests for filing incidental civil actions by fundraising participants shall not be accepted.

11. Regarding the Connection between Administrative Law Enforcement and Criminal Justice

During the investigation of illegal fundraising activities or the process of administrative law enforcement, if the functional department for handling illegal fundraising or the relevant competent administrative department considers the case to be major, difficult, or complex, it may consult with the Public Security organ for advice or reference opinions on issues such as prosecution standards and evidence fixation; if it finds that the illegal fundraising activity is suspected of a crime, it shall, in accordance with the Provisions on the Transfer of Suspected Criminal Cases by Administrative Enforcement Organs and other regulations, go through the relevant procedures and transfer the case to the Public Security organ within the prescribed time limit.

When handling criminal cases of illegal fundraising, the People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, and Public Security organs may consult with the functional department for handling illegal fundraising or the relevant competent administrative department to assign professional personnel to cooperate in the work, assist in consulting and copying relevant professional materials, and issue expert opinions on the professional issues involved in the case. Matters requiring administrative handling shall be promptly transferred to the functional department for handling illegal fundraising or the relevant competent administrative department for handling according to law.

12. Regarding the Legal Liability of State Functionaries

Where a state functionary engages in any of the following acts and the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law:

(1) Knowingly that the institution or business applied for by a unit or individual is suspected of illegal fundraising, yet still granting administrative license or registration procedures for it;

(2) Knowingly that the unit under their supervision or management is suspected of illegal fundraising, yet failing to handle it according to law in a timely manner or failing to transfer it to the functional department for handling illegal fundraising;

(3) Abusing power, neglecting duty, or engaging in malpractice for personal gain during the investigation and handling of illegal fundraising;

(4) Engaging in malpractice for personal gain by failing to transfer a criminal case of illegal fundraising to the judicial organs;

(5) Other acts of supporting, assisting, or condoning illegal fundraising through official acts or by using official influence.
